description: Illustrative single-GPU cloud machine for testing the estimators. Values are examples, not verified specifications for a real instance. Replace them before making deployment decisions.
notes: All GPU capacities and bandwidths describe one GPU; CPU RAM and storage describe one node.
GiB means 2^30 bytes. Bandwidth GB/s means 10^9 bytes per second. TFLOPS means 10^12 floating-point operations per second.
Dense Tensor Core peaks exclude sparsity multipliers and are theoretical ceilings, not achieved training throughput.
Available RAM, storage and other GPU usage are example snapshots, not guarantees.
null means unspecified; it does not imply unsupported hardware or zero bandwidth.
The runtime estimator requires effective GPU-GPU/network bandwidth for multi-GPU jobs.
GPU count and distributed strategy must also be set consistently in the workload or deployment configuration.
The offload paths are placeholders and must exist on the target machine when training.
